about: Phase 8 question set. Each answerable question lists the pieces of evidence that answer it ('evidence', quoted from the text as the loader extracts it; a list of quotes means the fact appears in several places and any of them counts) and the facts a correct answer must contain ('facts': every group needs one of its alternatives, case-insensitive). 'forbidden' strings must not appear (tempting facts the documents don't state). Kinds: single (one passage), multi (several passages, possibly from different documents), unanswerable (on-topic, but the documents don't say), off_topic (nothing to do with the documents).
